timeline.summary: Sheela Foam received listing and trading approval for 4,88,146 equity shares issued under the composite scheme of arrangement.
CRISIL Ratings revised Sheela Foam's long-term bank facilities rating outlook to Positive from Stable at CRISIL AA-.
Sheela Foam reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,050 Cr (+24% YoY) and PAT of ₹92 Cr.
Sheela Foam completed the distribution of ₹3.07 lakh fractional entitlement sale proceeds to eligible shareholders on May 8, 2026.
Sheela Foam Limited shared the audio recording link for its Investors’ Conference Call on May 15, 2026, held post Q4 FY2026 financial results.
Sheela Foam recommended its first-ever dividend of 20% for FY26 following successful Kurlon integration and debt reduction.
Rahul Gautam, Promoter & Executive Chairman, declares no new encumbrances on Sheela Foam shares for FY2025-26 beyond prior disclosures.
India Ratings affirmed Sheela Foam's bank facilities at IND AA/Stable and assigned ratings to ₹180 Cr of new limits.
